verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community account of a real JumpCloud security incident. It says the vendor proactively rotated API keys, recommended rotating SSO certs and 'handled the aftermath very well', which is thin, indirect evidence of honest disclosure behavior. The pack contains no first-party postmortem and no trust page. missing for 10: a published first-party incident postmortem, a live trust/security page, a documented disclosure history, and first-party corroboration of incident communications.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can judge the vendor's own record — published security incident postmortems, a live trust page, and honest disclosure history

citations.quote: They automatically rotated API keys, which I presume was how the attackers were accessing the platform and recommended rotating all SSO certs.
they've handled the aftermath very well
